contribution_types.description:
Suggested 6 ways to improve DAO

Proposal 1
Don’t raise the bar too high for prospects to enter into ecosystem 
the danger of constantly raising the bar to allow new member entry.

This problem happened in a lot of the other DAOs he invested in as they mature. 

They end up f**king things up. He mentioned EOS which he was one of the early founding member of went down the same route. 

Proposal 2
Now that we already have the onboarding process for exporters to USA to onboard, he proposed started doing the same for other countries. 

The more we can streamline the legal barrier the faster more importers and exporters can come onboard. It’s like building the Twilio infrastructure before the SMS problem was solved.  

Proposal 3
Revive the telegram channels (WhatApps requires member to reveal their phone numbers) 

He is hanging around in our Telegram channel at the moment 

Proposal 4
New prospective members shouldn’t need to have to read the white paper before they can start contributing. Dish bite size quest into channels where non token holders can immediately engage 

Proposal 5
When someone new join channel immediately reach out for a one on one to engage and manually figure out
     - self actualization desire
     - super power
     - figure out how to immediately deploy super power within DaO if possible 

Proposal 6
DAO member tiering system where they can graduate from one level to another as their level of contribution increases 

LangChain has implemented similar design pattern

narrative.text: Svet Svitlo contributed once to TrueSight DAO on November 7, 2023, reviewing a proposed strategy in the Build Game and suggesting a clear, specific actionable step.
